tools.name: get_user_profile
tools.description: Read a user's experience, goal, available_days, session_minutes, equipment, and preferences.

user_id.description: Account ID: the API's user_id / student_id, e.g. demo_user.

tools.name: get_timetable
tools.description: Read a user's weekly availability and planned workouts, each with its workout_id and saved feedback.

user_id.description: Account ID: the API's user_id / student_id, e.g. demo_user.

tools.name: save_workout_feedback
tools.description: Save feedback for a completed workout. Call only when the user explicitly asks to log it.

user_id.description: Account ID: the API's user_id / student_id, e.g. demo_user.

difficulty.description: How the workout felt. Stored as the API values slightly_too_easy, just_right, and slightly_too_hard respectively.

notes.description: Optional user comment, stored as the API's comment field.
